title: Holovessel star map (holovessel.starmap/v1)
description: One question saved as the steps it took, so it can be carried away and run again on another day. Tool steps are read-only and run again; partner steps are a record of what was asked of another site and whether the visitor agreed, and are never run without the visitor. Concept: Helen AphroIcy.

args.description: The tool's own arguments, as at the MCP door (tools/list).

summary.description: What it said then, in one line.

digest.description: A fingerprint of what mattered in the result then; a run compares against it.

kept.description: What stayed in the visitor's browser and was never sent.

again.description: on-return: run it again when the visitor comes back.
